bulkMAE: stateless bulk-transcriptomics adapters

Source: R/access.R
bulkMAE-package.Rd

bulkMAE uses MultiAssayExperiment as its public data contract, resolves one SummarizedExperiment leaf and its aligned sample metadata, then returns the native result produced by an established analysis backend. It does not mutate the input object or keep an analysis-status registry.

Details

Start with mae_create() or import_tximport(), inspect alignment with mae_validate() and mae_samples(), and then call an analysis family such as qc_*, de_*, enrich_*, coexpr_*, or surv_*. Statistical engines are optional dependencies and are checked only when their adapter is called.

See also

vignette("getting-started", package = "bulkMAE")
